name: Whole wheat flour
storage: Airtight steel or plastic container in a cool, dry cupboard: 2–3 months after opening. In hot, humid Mumbai months it keeps longer in the fridge (up to about 6 months). A couple of bay leaves in the tin is a common home trick against weevils.
looksLike: Fine, light brown to creamy-beige flour with tiny bran specks. Feels soft between the fingers and smells faintly nutty and wheaty.
howToPick: Choose a recent manufacturing date (atta keeps best within 2–3 months of milling). The flour should smell fresh and wheaty, not sour, musty or bitter. Avoid packs with lumps, webbing, small insects or a damp feel.
shelfLife: Usually 3–4 months from packing (check the pack); loose chakki atta is best used within 1–2 months.

usedIn.raw: 80 g in the dough, plus about 10 g for dusting (about 5 g of it gets used)
